subject: Medford Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram
overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted a 'Fresh Fridays' event featuring a public interview and poetry reading with Medford Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram followed by a performance by Kadan's Jazz.

items.title: Interview with Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram
items.summary: Host Terry Carter interviewed Medford Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram about her inaugural year in the role, including the launch of a new library poetry club and an open mic series at Arts Collaborative Medford. They discussed her background as a professor and the publication of her poetry collection, Fractured Lens.

items.title: Poetry Reading
items.summary: Sundaram and Carter shared several original poems addressing diverse themes such as athletics, social justice, immigration policy, and Haitian history.

items.title: Community Announcements
items.summary: Carter provided updates on senior lunch services, called for year-end tax-deductible donations, and announced the upcoming annual Martin Luther King Jr. Day celebration scheduled for January 20, 2025.

items.title: Performance by Kadan's Jazz
items.summary: The five-piece ensemble Kadan's Jazz performed a set of world-influenced music blending American jazz with Haitian, Brazilian, and French Caribbean rhythms.
